stem: Acute HAV infection is confirmed in the acute/early convalescent phase by which serology?

options.label: A
options.misconception: None; IgM anti-HAV confirms acute HAV.
options.explanation: CDC: IgM anti-HAV confirms acute infection.

options.label: B
options.text: Only anti-HBs alone after recovery from HBV
options.misconception: HBV serology. (does not match the cited teaching point).
